title: GET CONTAINER BYTEOFFSET: reads from offset 0, the middle, the last byte, past the container's remaining data, a negative offset, after a PREPEND, and an offset at or past the end (LENGERR RESP2 12)

scenarios.summary: CABOFF puts a 10-byte BIT container and gets it with BYTEOFFSET 0, 3, 9, 7 (FLENGTH above what is left: 3 bytes come back) and -1 (zero assumed); PREPENDs two bytes and reads at 0 and 10; FLENGTH comes back as the length returned
CABOFFX gets a 10-byte container at BYTEOFFSET 9 (NORMAL, 1 byte), 10 and 15 (LENGERR RESP2 12 each: the offset is at or past the end), then from 0 to show the container is unchanged
